about: Body proportion chart (Brief 6 delivery, 6 Nov 2026): usual [min, usual, max] metres per gender.age row, ratio ranges with cartoon allowances, build multipliers per row. Research-informed estimates, not measured percentiles (see notes/body-proportions-SOURCES.md). Stature for films comes from sizes.json standards (Bangladeshi national); this chart gives the SHAPES. scripts/build-bodies.mjs turns it into engine/cartoon/bodies.js.

sources.title: WHO Child Growth Standards: height-for-age, 2–5 years
sources.use: Toddler stature at 30 months; normal approximation using published median and SD.

sources.title: WHO Growth reference 5–19 years: height-for-age
sources.use: Stature at 72, 108, 144 and 186 months; approximate P10/P90 reconstructed from P15/P85.

sources.title: Asadujjaman et al. (2021), Stature estimation from handprint measurements
sources.use: Bangladeshi young-adult stature sample; not national norms. No handprint-to-hand-width conversion.

sources.title: Snyder et al. (1977), Anthropometry of Infants, Children, and Youths to Age 18
sources.use: Historical measurement taxonomy only; numerical front widths were not extracted.

sources.title: Fryar et al. (2021), Anthropometric Reference Data, United States, 2015–2018
sources.use: Measurement definitions and external plausibility reference; survey arm length is not a joint-centre bone length.

sources.title: NASA Human Integration Design Handbook, Revision 1
sources.use: Multivariate anthropometry and measurement consistency; not a source of every numeric field.

sources.title: Sorkin et al. (1999), Longitudinal change in height of men and women
sources.use: Longitudinal age-related stature loss; elder values here interpolate and extrapolate to a representative age of 75.

sources.title: Guffey et al. (2016), Gait parameters associated with balance in healthy 2–4 year-old children
sources.use: Toddler walking magnitudes; authored coherent gait triplets are not study percentiles.

sources.title: Oberg et al. (1993), Basic gait parameters: reference data for normal subjects, 10–79 years
sources.use: Age and sex context for gait; no literal per-row normative transcription.

sources.title: Kerr et al. (1997), Analysis of the sit-stand-sit movement cycle in normal subjects
sources.use: Single rise/descent timing reference; all exported age ranges are animation estimates.

sources.title: Tweed et al. (1995), Eye-head coordination during large gaze shifts
sources.use: Eased head-turn velocity profile; exported speeds are authored, not measured norms.

sources.title: South Asian and European body-fat distribution study, PMID 8653149
sources.use: Supports avoiding one universal body-shape multiplier; no direct conversion of circumference or fat mass to front width.

sources.title: Walt Disney Animation Studios: Animation
sources.use: Timing, anticipation, follow-through, staging and secondary action inform optional action phases.

sources.title: Zancut authored engineering estimates, 2026-11-06
sources.use: All non-stature dimensions, build multipliers, cartoon limits, global art envelopes and action prescriptions are estimates; not population percentiles.

buildApplication.priority: Use full buildOverrides[rowId][build]. builds[sex] is an adult-only compatibility fallback.
buildApplication.formula: builtMeasure = averageMeasure * multiplier, elementwise; average multiplier is 1.0.
buildApplication.ratios: Recompute from built measures before applying cartoon allowances. Precomputed results are in optional-extras/build-profiles.json.
buildApplication.meaning: Shape presets, not BMI categories or medical weight classifications.

cartoonNotes.headHeight/stature: Up to 15% larger for toddler–child12, 8% for teens, 5% for adults/elders; lower limit 95% of base.
cartoonNotes.shoulderWidth/stature: Allow 5% either side of the selected build envelope; retain age-specific shoulder form.
cartoonNotes.hipWidth/stature: Allow 5% either side of the selected build envelope; do not infer gender identity from shape.
cartoonNotes.shoulderWidth/hipWidth: Allow 5% either side; overlapping female and male shapes are intentional.
cartoonNotes.waistWidth/hipWidth: Allow 5% either side; avoid automatically giving children an adult waist.
cartoonNotes.upperArmWidth/stature: Adult/elder female: permit 10% thinner and no extra thickening beyond the selected build; others 5% either side.
cartoonNotes.forearmWidth/stature: Permit 5% either side; keep wrists narrower than forearms.
cartoonNotes.thighWidth/stature: Permit 5% either side of the build-specific envelope.
cartoonNotes.calfWidth/stature: Permit 5% either side; preserve the narrower ankle.
cartoonNotes.upperArmWidth/thighWidth: Adult/elder female: permit 10% thinner arms and no upward expansion; others 5% either side.
cartoonNotes.(upperArmLength+forearmLength)/stature: Permit 3% either side; change endpoints and derived floor heights together.
cartoonNotes.(thighLength+shinLength)/stature: Permit 3% either side; preserve age-specific leg length and grounded ankles.
cartoonNotes.crotchHeight/stature: Permit 3% either side; crotch is a surface landmark, not the hip pivot.
